children: The total value of the cryptocurrency holdings held by the US government stands at about $20.57 billion.
According to on-chain analytics platform Onchain Lens on Nov. 14, the US government currently holds a range of digital assets, including 306,790 Bitcoin and 17,430 Ether.
The combined value of those crypto holdings was estimated at about $20.57 billion.

title: US Government Holds 306,790 Bitcoin, Crypto Valued at $20.57 Billion
